digest.component_or_area: Commit trailer repair and close-gate file-impact validation
propositions: A CLI verb `rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>...` must record COMMITS events retroactively, with all-or-nothing SHA validation before any event is appended.
The same attach-commits seam must be exposed on library (rebar.attach_commits), CLI, and MCP surfaces, inheriting unified SHA validation via commit_impact.invalid_commit_shas.

A deterministic close-gate check in close_precheck.py must block if any discovered commit's changed paths are not covered by declared file_impact or exemption globs, naming offending paths and commits.
Merge commits must be skipped in the close-gate path analysis; git errors from local commits fail closed, while unresolvable remote commits are skipped.
A shared DET module commit_impact.py must consolidate glob matching and SHA validation without importing rebar.llm, and existing _glob_match copies in prompts.py and registry.py must delegate to it.

The close-gate file_impact scope must union all file_impact across the same transitive descendant id set used for commit discovery, preventing false blocks on parent tickets when children declare paths.
